name: Seed Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as seedcapital.dk, Copenhagen seed VC (Højbro Plads 10) with Trustpilot, Lunar, Templafy, Vivino, Veo and Flatpay in its portfolio. Tech.eu covers its Fund V close. Not Seed Capital Investments or other firms named Seed Capital.

pages.title: Seed Capital closes €130M Fund V to expand across the Nordics

website.snippet: We partner with remarkable entrepreneurs across the Nordics to build global winners.

thesis_text.value: Nordic seed investor concentrating on fintech and AI-driven B2B, with cybersecurity and resilience newly added; Fund V targets 15-17 companies.
thesis_text.snippet: Fintech and AI-driven B2B, plus cybersecurity and resilience as a new focus
